_comment: x280 serial-fleet bench: enrollment + health contract. Consoles resolve by FTDI serial (by-id), never by ttyUSB index (index drifts on replug). Addresses are the bench-side reachable ones measured 2026-10-26. No passwords live here: access is the bench publickey (default ~/.ssh/id_bench, overridable TOLLGATE_BENCH_KEY). The dark port is recorded, not hidden: it stays enrolled=false until it answers.
